episodes.title: Goodbye to All That
episodes.plot: A new satellite dish mesmerizes Shelly while Joel receives a devastating breakup letter from Elaine and struggles to accept that his old New York future has moved on.

episodes.title: The Big Kiss
episodes.plot: Ed seeks spiritual help to learn who his parents were, while Chris mysteriously loses his voice after meeting a beautiful stranger and searches for an equally unusual cure.

episodes.title: All is Vanity
episodes.plot: Holling considers circumcision for Shelly, Maggie invents an elaborate lie for her visiting father, and Cicely gathers to keep vigil over an unidentified dead man.

episodes.title: What I Did for Love
episodes.plot: Maggie's dream of Joel dying makes him question a trip home and the doctor covering for him, while Maurice enjoys the attention of an astronaut admirer.

episodes.title: Spring Break
episodes.plot: Cicely's spring thaw sends desire into overdrive: Joel and Maggie invade each other's dreams, Maurice falls for Officer Semanski and Shelly becomes obsessed with romantic literature.

episodes.title: War and Peace
episodes.plot: Russian celebrity Nikolai returns for gifts, chess and an old feud with Maurice, while Chris secretly supplies the romantic prose Ed uses to woo Light Feather.

episodes.title: Slow Dance
episodes.plot: Maggie's boyfriend Rick is killed by a falling satellite, while a gay couple tests Maurice's prejudices and Holling's old female friend stirs Shelly's jealousy.
